technical_and_design_decisions: Externalize Kafka test execution settings using Gradle project properties or environment variables to allow seamless execution against a separate external broker process.
Modify log pattern in 'config/xd-container-logger.properties' to include standard date format (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss,SSS) before time/severity.
Refactor 'publish-maven.gradle' to dynamically load property key-value pairs from central 'dependencies.properties'.
Develop the Spark batch job sample as a standard Spring XD module sample with build configuration and documentation.
Review Sonar static analysis report to fix code quality bugs/vulnerabilities and mark non-applicable rules as false-positives or invalid in Sonar Qube server.
assumptions: Developer has repository write permissions and administrative/editor permissions on the project wiki.
SonarQube dashboard is active and accessible for the project.
An external Kafka broker or standalone process can be provisioned locally or in CI environment during test execution.
No major structural breaking changes are required for existing Scala Spark streaming deployment mechanisms.

activities.activity_name: Scala Spark Streaming Module Deployment Support (U1)
activities.activity_description: Validate and fix packaging/deployment mechanisms so Scala-based Spark Streaming modules can be deployed smoothly into Spring XD.
Create new 'Troubleshooting' section on the project Wiki and document recommended ulimit setting (10K) along with the 'Too many open files' exception context.

activities.activity_name: Add Date to Container Logs Property (U3)
activities.activity_description: Update 'config/xd-container-logger.properties' log layout pattern to include date in container log output.

activities.activity_name: External/Separate Process Kafka Test Configuration (U4 & U6)
activities.activity_description: Refactor Kafka integration tests to connect to a separate/external running Kafka server process rather than embedding inside build JVM, reducing build footprint.

activities.activity_name: Central Dependency Version Sourcing in Gradle Script (U5)
activities.activity_description: Update 'publish-maven.gradle' to pull dependency version properties (e.g. Spring Boot, hadoop-common) directly from 'dependencies.properties'.
Inspect active Sonar violations, fix relevant code quality issues in source code, and flag non-relevant/false positive items in the Sonar interface.
Implement a sample Spark batch job application showcasing distributed data computation capabilities within Spring XD, including sample configuration and README guide.
Execute full test suite, verify gradle build script outputs, and validate log formats and sample execution.
